claims.claim: Amazon Ads provides advanced tools that give developers the ability to programmatically create and manage campaigns, as well as retrieve performance data.
claims.quote: Amazon Ads provides a number of advanced tools that give developers the ability to programmatically create and manage campaigns, as well as retrieve performance data.

claims.claim: Translations of the Amazon Ads developer guides are available in select languages.
claims.quote: Translations of these developer guides are available in select languages.

claims.claim: Using all Amazon Ads developer tools requires first completing an onboarding process that includes registering an application and applying for access to the API.
claims.quote: To use all developer tools, you must first complete the onboarding process which includes registering an application and applying for access to the API.

claims.claim: Developers can use the Amazon Ads API and Amazon Marketing Stream to access performance metrics for Amazon Ads campaigns.
claims.quote: Developers can use the Amazon Ads API and Amazon Marketing Stream to access performance metrics for Amazon Ads campaigns.

claims.claim: The Amazon Ads API supports asynchronous report requests.
claims.quote: The Ads API supports asynchronous report requests

claims.claim: Amazon Marketing Stream provides near real-time access to metrics through the user's AWS account.
claims.quote: Amazon Marketing Stream provides near real-time access to metrics through your AWS account.

claims.claim: Campaigns can now be managed across ad products using a common model and a single set of API endpoints.
claims.quote: You can now manage campaigns across ad products using a common model and a single set of API endpoints.

claims.claim: The new cross-ad-product campaign management capabilities are part of the Amazon Ads API v1.
claims.quote: To get started with campaign management in the Amazon Ads API v1, see the [campaign management overview](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/guides/campaign-management/overview).

claims.claim: The Amazon Ads API can also be used to create and manage sponsored ads and Amazon DSP campaigns.
claims.quote: You can also use the Amazon Ads API to create and manage sponsored ads and Amazon DSP campaigns.

claims.claim: Amazon Ads documentation includes a guide for creating a Sponsored Display campaign aimed at Amazon sellers or vendors.
claims.quote: Create a Sponsored Display campaign (Amazon sellers or vendors)

claims.claim: Amazon Ads documentation includes a separate guide for creating a Sponsored Display campaign aimed at advertisers that do not sell on Amazon.
claims.quote: Create a Sponsored Display campaign (advertisers that do not sell on Amazon)

claims.claim: The Amazon Ads advanced tools documentation is maintained in a public GitHub repository at github.com/amzn/ads-advanced-tools-docs.
